parameters.query: INSERT INTO clients (client_code, company_name, domain, contact_email, contact_name, plan_type, status, api_key, webhook_secret, config) VALUES ('{{ $json.client_code }}', '{{ $json.company_name }}', '{{ $json.domain }}', '{{ $json.email }}', '{{ $json.contact_name }}', '{{ $json.plan_type }}', 'onboarding', '{{ $json.api_key }}', '{{ $json.webhook_secret }}', '{{ JSON.stringify({onboarding_steps: $json.onboarding_steps, signup_at: new Date().toISOString()}) }}'::jsonb) RETURNING id, client_code, api_key

parameters.subject: Welcome to GreeVo! Let's get you set up 🚀

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ success: true, client_code: $node['Create Account'].json.client_code, api_key: $node['Create Account'].json.api_key, next_step: 'Configure your domain', setup_url: 'https://' + ($env.COMPANY_DOMAIN || 'app.greevo.id') + '/setup/' + $node['Create Account'].json.client_code }) }}

parameters.query: UPDATE clients SET config = jsonb_set(config, '{onboarding_progress}', (COALESCE(config->'onboarding_progress', '0')::int + 1)::text::jsonb) WHERE client_code = '{{ $json.client_code }}' RETURNING id, config
